messages.message: The “type” attribute is unnecessary for JavaScript resources.
An “img” element must have an “alt” attribute, except under certain conditions. For details, consult guidance on providing text alternatives for images.
Bad value “50%” for attribute “width” on element “img”: Expected a digit but saw “%” instead.
Start tag “a” seen but an element of the same type was already open.
The “border” attribute on the “table” element is obsolete. Consider specifying “img { border: 0; }” in CSS instead.
The “align” attribute on the “table” element is obsolete. Use CSS instead.
Bad value “” for attribute “action” on element “form”: Must be non-empty.
To set the document’s location as the action for a form, omit the “action” attribute.
Bad value “false” for attribute “required” on element “input”.
Bad value “link” for attribute “type” on element “button”.
The “frameborder” attribute on the “iframe” element is obsolete. Use CSS instead.
The value of the “for” attribute of the “label” element must be the ID of a non-hidden form control.
